hero.title:
ZEPPELIN
BEACH COMPLEX
hero.subtitle: Your base for chill — and the start of every adventure.

bar.heading: Chill at the highest level.
bar.description: Kick back with perfect cocktails, music, and a view of the sea. Great vibes, sunbeds, and shaded terraces waiting for you every day.
bar.sunbed_info: Info at the water sports desk

action.heading: On water, in the air, on land.
action.note: Pay at the water sports info desk

wibit.description: An inflatable obstacle course on open water — test your balance, race your friends, and battle the obstacles. Open for all ages.
wibit.pay_note: Pay at the water sports desk

tramp.description: A water trampoline anchored just off the shore — jump high, flip, and land in the sea. Pure fun for all ages.
tramp.pay_note: Pay at the water sports desk

pedaline.description: Pedal boats for families and groups, stand-up paddleboards for those who like a challenge. Navigate the bay and enjoy the view.
pedaline.pay_note: Pay at the water sports desk

tube.description: High-speed rides on the sea — pick your tube, grab the handles, and get dragged across the waves at full throttle. Multiple configurations available.
tube.pay_note: Pay at the water sports desk

adventure.heading: Book your adventure.
adventure.subtitle: Unforgettable experiences — book online, depart from our beach.

fastfood_page.description: Burgers, sandwiches, and grilled favourites made fresh on-site. Quick service so you spend less time in line and more time on the beach.

gelato_page.description: Handcrafted gelato and smoothie bowls made with fresh ingredients. The perfect stop between dips in the sea.

careers.heading: Join the Zeppelin team.
careers.subtitle: Apply for the season and work on the most beautiful beach in Pula.
careers.position_select_heading: Which position are you applying for?

position_categories.label: Zeppelin Adventures
position_categories.notice: Buggy and Quad require a valid driving licence. Jetski requires a valid skipper licence.

careers.success_msg: Thank you! We'll be in touch soon.

location.heading: Find us.
location.directions: We're on Saccorgiana Beach in Pula. Follow signs for "Zeppelin Beach" from the city centre.
